run_html_senteval: run the HTML model embedding evaluation on SentEval transfer tasks using a pretrained serialization directory
compute_embds_from_layer: compute averaged embeddings from a specified encoder layer of the HTML model for a batch of sentences
create_text_to_instance: create an AllenNLP Instance from a list of tokenized words using a token indexer
build_sentences_to_indexed_batch: build an indexed AllenNLP Batch from a list of sentence token lists
test_senteval_transfer_tasks: test the HTML model embeddings on 10 SentEval transfer tasks including Length, Tense, and Depth
